content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE - Gamma DataWorks (dedicated pool, VPC eu-west-1)
incident-bot: Alerts: traces and logs missing for tenant=gamma-dw for inference-service and reranker since ~03:12 UTC. Paging @sara (oncall).

sara (oncall): acked. Can someone confirm scope — all services for tenant or specific lanes/shards?

gamma-sre: We're only seeing absent spans and no forwarder PutObject success logs for the gamma forwarder from 03:11:30 -> 03:16:00. Metrics show p95 latency spike and increased error rates at 03:12.

tim: Pulling assigner state and Kinesis consumer group offsets. No deploys in that window from platform side.

maria (eng-obs): Our ingestion pipeline logs show Kinesis consumer throwing 401/403 to the forwarder endpoint starting 03:11:45. Correlated with KMS envelope rekey activity for tenant.

leo (eng-platform): Note: because Gamma DataWorks is in a private VPC, their forwarder encrypts to a customer-managed key and uploads to our intermediate S3. If their key is rotated without updated envelope access we won't be able to process objects.

sara (oncall): @gamma-sre did you rotate any keys or change IAM roles around 03:00-03:10?

gamma-sre: We rotated an encryption KMS key at 03:06 UTC as part of routine rotation. The forwarder restarted at 03:09 and began returning 403 to our Kinesis ingestion until it retried with the new key.

dave (platform-eng): A KMS rotation can break the envelope encryption for in-flight batches. If the forwarder can't decrypt, it may drop objects or fail PutObject auth. We need a temporary read-only role to backfill.

sara (oncall): Temporary mitigation plan:
1) Request temporary role (arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/GammaDW-RedwoodSupport) with s3:GetObject for forwarder bucket
2) Open support tunnel (SMP) to their VPC for live troubleshooting
3) Run trace backfill for gap window 03:09:00-03:20:00 UTC
4) Add tenant-scoped alert for forwarder auth errors and Kinesis 4xx spike

tim: Filing support ticket SM-60211 and opening tunnel. @gamma-sre please allowlist 52.23.11.45. Ticket: https://redwood.support/SM-60211

gamma-sre: Allowlist updated, role created: arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/GammaDW-RedwoodSupport with s3:GetObject limited to prefix gamma-forwarder/2026-04-02/.

maria (eng-obs): Preparing backfill job. Command we will run after role validation:

```
./backfill_traces --source s3://gamma-dw-forwarder/2026-04-02/ --start 2026-04-02T03:09:00Z --end 2026-04-02T03:20:00Z \
  --tenant gamma-dw --decrypt-role arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/GammaDW-RedwoodSupport
```

maria (eng-obs): Estimated spans missing ~9.8k. Backfill ETA 10-16m after role is usable. Will stream ingestion progress.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-04-02-114. Severity assigned: Sev2. Handoff paging to @leo (primary).

leo (eng-platform): Taking over. Coordinating with infra on shard assigner and consumer group health. @tim any config changes to the assigner?

tim: No assigner edits. We see the KMS rotation correlation only. No platform-side code changes.

gamma-sre: After role grant we see successful GetObject from 52.23.11.45. Confirmed access at 03:28 UTC.

maria (eng-obs): Backfill started at 03:29 UTC. Current ingestion progress: 45% of window processed. Observability gap closing.

sara (oncall): Customer impact summary for execs: Gamma DataWorks experienced missing E2E traces and elevated p95 for inference-service from ~03:12 to 03:29 UTC. We'll provide timeline and remediation in postmortem.

dave (platform-eng): Action item: create infra alert rule — tenant forwarder auth failure >5min triggers Sev2. Also update runbook for KMS rotations in private VPC tenants.

maria (eng-obs): Backfill complete. Re-ingested 9,842 spans. Trace continuity restored; latency p95 returned to normal within ~2 minutes post-ingestion.

sara (oncall): Closing active paging. Incident remains open for postmortem and runbook updates. :white_check_mark:

gamma-sre: We'll add a step to coordinated KMS rotations with Redwood and test forwarder restarts in staging before prod. Thanks for the quick triage.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to Mitigated -> Monitoring. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-04-02-114/postmortem. Next steps: retro, alert rollout, runbook updates.
